en.title: Lilly Wachowski Joins 'iHunt' Film Adaptation as Executive Producer
en.summary: A modern horror story about monster hunting in the gig economy is heading to the big screen. The acclaimed novel and tabletop RPG 'iHunt: Killing Monsters in the Gig Economy' is getting a feature film adaptation with a notable producer attached.
en.body:
The world of indie horror is getting a major boost with the announcement that **Lilly Wachowski**, co-creator of the groundbreaking **Matrix** franchise, is executive producing the film adaptation of **‘iHunt: Killing Monsters in the Gig Economy’**. This project brings to life the unique concept of a monster-hunting business operating within the fragmented, often exploitative, landscape of the gig economy.

Directed by **Scott Glosserman**, known for his work on **‘Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon’**, the film is based on the independently distributed novel series and tabletop RPG created by **Hill and Young**. Olivia Hill penned the screenplay, promising to translate the source material's blend of horror and social commentary to the visual medium. The film will also introduce a new character, Sandra, brought to life by actress **Jess Elgene**. Production is underway in association with Anarchists United Studios, with **Sarah Marie Flores** and **Lawrence Mattis** also serving as executive producers alongside Wachowski.

## A Modern Monster Hunt

The premise of **‘iHunt’** is what sets it apart: a group of individuals who take on dangerous, supernatural contracts through a mobile app, essentially treating monster slaying as a freelance gig. This setup offers a fertile ground for exploring themes of worker exploitation, the search for meaning in unstable employment, and the very real dangers faced by those in the gig economy, amplified by monstrous threats. The involvement of **Lilly Wachowski**, a filmmaker known for her innovative storytelling and engagement with complex societal themes, suggests a commitment to exploring these ideas with depth and nuance. Her presence signals a significant level of creative ambition for the project, potentially drawing a wider audience beyond just hardcore horror aficionados.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans of the **‘iHunt’** books and RPG, this adaptation is a dream come true. The series has cultivated a passionate following drawn to its clever concept, compelling characters, and sharp critique of modern labor. The addition of **Lilly Wachowski** to the production team is particularly exciting, aligning with her known interest in genre filmmaking and socially conscious narratives. The casting of **Jess Elgene** as Sandra, a new character, also offers a fresh element for both existing fans and newcomers to discover. The project promises to deliver a fresh take on horror, one that feels incredibly relevant to contemporary anxieties while delivering on the thrills of monster hunting.

## What's Next

With production underway and key creative talent secured, details regarding filming locations and a potential release window are anticipated. Fans will be eager to see how **Scott Glosserman** translates the unique blend of horror and gig economy satire to the screen.
